title: Add a stats endpoint
body:
Add `GET /links/:slug/stats` returning `200` with:

```json
{ "slug": "abc123", "url": "https://...", "clicks": 2, "lastClickedAt": "2026-01-01T00:01:00.000Z" }
```

- `clicks` counts redirects served for the slug.
- `lastClickedAt` is the ISO time of the most recent redirect, or `null` if never clicked.
- Unknown slug → `404`.
